name: box_blur_default_opaque
source: var w=new Window(),p=new Layer(w,null),l=new Layer(w,p);l.setImageSize(7,4);l.face=1;for(var y=0;y<4;y++) for(var x=0;x<7;x++) {l.setMainPixel(x,y,(((x*71+y*39)%256)<<16)|(((x*31+y*97)%256)<<8)|((x*151+y*17)%256));l.setMaskPixel(x,y,(x*53+y*79)%256);}l.doBoxBlur();var out=[];for(var y=0;y<4;y++) for(var x=0;x<7;x++) out.add(l.getMainPixel(x,y)+":"+l.getMaskPixel(x,y));return out.join(",");
